42f422b291575e35.jd: 🌍 Global SaaS | $28M Series B Investment 📍 Remote in Europe     The Mission  As the Director of Product, you will lead the product organization to move with  conviction, speed, and evidence . You are responsible for leading a team of Product Managers, Designers and Product Operations to ensure we are solving high-impact problems and building the  leanest, most impactful solutions  for our customers and the business.  You will act as the primary strategic force for the executive team, front-running strategy and managing stakeholder expectations, owning the tactical translation of strategy into a coherent, high-velocity roadmap, so that the roadmap remains proactive, data-driven, and aligned with our commercial goals. Your goal is to be a "Player-Coach" who deep-dives into the domain with PMs to ensure excellent execution habits. You are the final gatekeeper who resolves blockers and scope disputes before they ever reach the CEO or CPTO, which will provide you and the teams with a level of autonomy in which to thrive.  You drive efficiency through an AI-First approach, while embracing SVPG style experimentation and pragmatic execution, and inject these principles into your teams. This allows you to closely align with the Director of Engineering and make Dual Track Agile a standard across the organization.     Key Responsibilities:   1. Elevating Product Discovery & Conviction    Advancing Empowered Squads : You will work to continually increase the level of empowerment within our squads. Moving beyond execution, you coach PMs to take deeper ownership of business outcomes, ensuring they are positioned to solve complex problems rather than just deliver features.   Continuous Discovery:  You own the standard for modern discovery. You ensure squads are in constant contact with users to (in)validate hypotheses before significant engineering resources are committed.   Bias to Action with Knowledge:  You move with high urgency but high conviction. Decisions must be rooted in user insights and market data, ensuring we are always "building the right thing."   2. The Product-Engineering Partnership (Dual-Track Agile)    Strategic Duo:  You work in a tight, peer-level partnership with the Director of Engineering to lead the "R&D engine." Together, you are responsible for the total health, culture, and output of the R&D organization.   Discovery vs. Delivery Alignment:  While you own the Discovery Track (validating value and usability), you collaborate daily with the Director of Engineering, who owns the Delivery Track (feasibility, scalability, and execution). You ensure these two tracks are synchronized and never siloed.   Resource & Trade-off Management:  You partner with Engineering leadership to manage capacity. You lead the difficult conversations regarding trade-offs between new feature discovery, technical debt, and maintenance, ensuring the business is always focused on the highest ROI activities.   3. Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management    The "Final Answer":  You are the primary gatekeeper for the product roadmap. You provide clear, definitive "Yes/No" decisions to executive stakeholders underpinned with knowledge of our customers and the necessary trade-offs.   Vacuum Prevention:  You identify misalignments early and resolve them across all swimlanes of the business.    Commercial Realism:  You translate high-level business goals (Retention, Revenue, Strategic Growth) into actionable priorities while aligning with the company’s core Key Results and Business Objectives.   4. Operational Excellence & People Leadership    Product Operations Mastery:  You view Product Ops as a strategic lever. You standardize discovery documentation and research databases across the organization to create a transparent, low-friction environment.   Outcome Accountability:  You manage the Product Scorecard and Rolling Roadmap. These must be high-integrity, automated "Sources of Truth" providing executive-level visibility.   Radical Candor:  You practice direct challenge combined with personal care. You are responsible for raising the "Product IQ" of your team—coaching PMs to think like owners and act with strategic independence.   5. Product Advocacy & Representation    Product Voice to the Company:  Serve as the primary representative of the Product organization in company-wide meetings (All Hands, Town Halls). You must be able to translate complex technical roadmaps into compelling narratives that inspire and align the entire business.   Evangelizing the Vision:  Actively advocate for the "Why" behind our product strategy. You ensure that Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success clearly understand our product direction, value propositions, and upcoming releases.   Presentation Excellence:  You possess elite presentation skills, utilizing the Pyramid Principle to deliver high-impact, succinct, and visually clear updates to both internal and external audiences.   6. Aggressive Scope Management & Lean Execution    The "Slicer":  You coach PMs to avoid "heavyweight" features. You have a relentless focus on building the leanest possible MVP, MSP, CMF, ILS solutions based on the need or pain. If a solution is over-scoped, you are the one who cuts it back to the core value.   Pushback & Scrappiness:  You teach PMs to find their “appetite” for investment into a solution and how to find "cheaper" ways to validate hypotheses. You empower them to push back on high-effort requests by proposing creative, lower-cost alternatives.   Deep-Dive Problem Solving:  You don’t stay at the surface. You sit with PMs to help them deeply understand core user problems to avoid building "to cover all bases" and relentlessly focus on solving the actual customer pain.      The Ideal Profile:     The High-Agency Leader:  You don't wait for permission; you identify gaps and fill them. You have a natural "bias to action" but are always grounded in data.   The SVPG & Cagan Practitioner:  You live and breathe modern product principles and know how to coach others to do the same.   The Elite Communicator:  You are a master of the Pyramid Principle. You can command a room, whether it’s a 3rd-person Exec meeting or a 200-person All Hands.   The Systems Thinker:  You look at the "R&D Engine" as a whole and work with your Engineering counterpart to optimize for both speed and quality.   Operational Source of Truth:  The Scorecard and Roadmap are automated and accurate, serving as the definitive guide for the executive team and the business.   The B2B SaaS Operator:  You have built and led product in a B2B SaaS environment — ideally with a sales-assisted and PLG motion and an ARR-driven commercial model.      Success Metrics (First 90 Days):     R&D Sync:  Established a seamless rhythm with the Director of Engineering; joint ownership of delivery velocity and discovery outcomes.   Strategic Visibility:  The "Rolling Roadmap" and "Scorecard" are live, automated, and being used by the Executive team without manual intervention.   Empowerment Baseline:  Documented "Discovery to Delivery" workflows for all 6 squads with clear KPIs for hypothesis validation.   Stakeholder Trust:  A measurable reduction in "Roadmap bypass" incidents; stakeholders rely on your "Final Answer." b04050849748e47d.jd: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:  If you’ve already completed the 20four7VA Recruiting Process—including the Final Interview—or have previously been contracted by a 20four7VA Client, please make sure to apply via the  20four7VA Team Portal  for faster processing.   Log in using your 20four7VA-issued email address to access the portal.   If you’ve just logged in to the Team Portal, please proceed to review the Independent Contractor Opportunity outlined below.   💡 Quick Tip: Upload your resume first—this will automatically populate most of the fields in the application form. Let the magic happen!   If you're interested in this opportunity, click APPLY TO POSITION to proceed.   ********************************************************************    Title: CPT-11376 Production Graphic Designer – Signage & Print    Independent Contractor – CPT-11376 Production Graphic Designer – Signage & Print/Marketing VA/Entry-Senior Level(Remote).    Overview    20four7VA is seeking offshore independent contractors to deliver remote services to clients worldwide, with a primary focus on developed markets such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia.   An established Maryland-based signage, printing, and promotional products company is seeking an experienced Production Graphic Designer to support a high-volume operation serving both individual customers and major commercial clients.  This is not primarily a Canva or template-based social media design position. The company needs a designer with practical experience creating, modifying, and preparing professional artwork for physical production, including signs, apparel, promotional products, storefront graphics, and other large-format applications.  The ideal candidate understands vector graphics, print-ready file preparation, scaling, resolution, and the practical differences between artwork that looks good on a screen and artwork that can successfully be produced at commercial scale. The Role  
 Help us build the operating system for human longevity. 
 Virtusan is a Swiss-based longevity ecosystem at the intersection of science, technology, and premium real-world experiences. We connect data, behaviour, and environments so people can live longer, better lives. We're a small team and offer real ownership from day one. 
 We need someone who owns their work completely: defines the experience, conducts the research, designs the flows, and iterates without waiting to be asked. 
 This is not just an execution role. You will shape how our app is used, how it guides people through their health data, and whether it actually changes how they live. You will be accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. The measure of your work is whether users build real habits, understand their biology, and come back because the product earns it. 
 Tasks 
  What You'll Own  
  Product concept and experience design  
 
 Originate new product concepts from scratch, not just improve what exists 
 Design complete user journeys that translate complex biometric data into clear, motivating daily guidance 
 Ensure every flow serves behaviour change, not just usability: ask why a feature exists and what it helps the user to accomplish, not just how it should work 
 Hold the line on experience quality across the full app 
 
  User research  
 
 Plan and run your own user research: interviews, usability tests, diary studies, and in-app feedback loops 
 Turn qualitative and quantitative signals into actionable design decisions 
 Build and maintain a clear picture of who our users are, what motivates them, and where we lose them 
 Bring user evidence into every design conversation 
 
  Design execution  
 
 Build and evolve our next app version with fast protoptyping in Figma or Claude Design moving fast without sacrificing foundamentals 
 Design for the constraints of mobile: clarity, performance, and one-handed use 
 Maintain our design library and high-fidelity mock ups. Ensure consistency across components, patterns, and interaction models 
 Collaborate closely with product and engineering to ship what you design 
 
  Iteration and quality  
 
 Define success metrics for your work and track them 
 Test your assumptions before and after launch 
 Spot what isn't working and fix it, with or without a brief 
 
 Requirements 
 
 6 to 7 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio that shows end-to-end ownership 
 Proven ability to originate product concepts, not just refine existing ones 
 Deep mobile app design experience: you understand iOS patterns, constraints, and work with a small screen 
 Strong user research skills: you design the study, run it, synthesise it, and act on it 
 Expert-level Figma skills and a clean, efficient design process. Experience with AI tools to accelerate the whole design process. 
 Fast prototyping and concept validation: you build lightweight, testable prototypes early to prove or disprove an idea before committing to full design. You iterate quickly on evidence and know when something is ready to build and when it isn't 
 Able to design for behaviour change: you understand how habits form and how design can support or undermine them 
 Strong written English: your product design copy is natural and is an integral part of your designed flows 
 Takes ownership: makes well-reasoned calls independently rather than waiting for direction 
 Based geographically in EU/UK timezone. Applications from Asia or the Americas will not be considered. 
 
  The following are strong advantages:  
 
 Experience in health, wellness, or longevity products 
 Experience building data products & data visualisations 
 B2C product experience 
 Fluency in German 
 
  Send a resume with a portfolio link or attachment showing work you have led: original concepts, user research, full journeys, shipped mobile experiences.

About Co-Star 
 Someone downloads Co–Star every 5 seconds.  
 In the five years since we launched, 25% of young people 18-25 in the US have downloaded the app.  Big Sean  has rapped about us, Ariana Grande &  Kevin Durant  post screenshots to their IGs, and we’ve been  App of the Day  twice. We’ve been featured in the New York Times three times, this year on the cover of  NYT Style . We have a global following, in 193 countries – missing just North Korea and Eritrea.  
 We don't pay for marketing – we designed the app to go viral, and it did.  
 Astrology has been popular for 4,000 years. 
 Astrology is a tool for speaking about yourself, about who you are, what you’re experiencing, and how you relate to other people – in other words, a language for the things that really matter. It’s a structured system, based on the physical locations of the planets in the sky, developed over millennia 4,000 years of practice.  
 Everyone has memories of reading a horoscope in the newspaper. You know your sign the same way you know the name of the street you grew up on.  An average of 43% of Americans have believed in astrology since the 1970s.   
 We’re merging the resonance of the humanities with the precision of technology.  
 Co-Star uses real-time NASA data and AI to bring this practice to the modern age. Every day, Co–Star generates millions of hyper-personalized horoscopes – a scale never previously possible. Every word of it is based on each person’s unique astrology: where the stars physically were when they were born and where those same stars are now. Co–Star combines the art of ancient practice with cutting-edge artificial intelligence, creating the first synthetic text to be called “wildly beautiful.” 
 We’re a small, experienced team.  
 Co-Star is a team of 30, with experience in big tech (Amazon, Google, Snapchat), entertainment (Frank Ocean, Adult Swim), and academia (Harvard, Stanford, NYU, Columbia).  
 About the brand designer role 
 We're looking for a talented visual designer to shape how Co-Star shows up outside of the app, in the broader world. We are looking for someone with a fresh, opinionated, and high-quality design foundation who can create work that feels distinct, not what’s now but what’s next.  
 You'll partner closely with the leadership on campaigns and visual storytelling across earned and owned channels. This is a freelance engagement with potential for a long-term partnership as the work (and team) grows. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Design campaign visuals: ads, social, launches — from concept through finished assets 
 Bring editorial design sensibility to our owned channels: email/welcome series, blog, campaign imagery 
 Develop visual systems that are expressive rather than corporate 
 Partner with marketing on what earned and owned should look and feel like 
 Collaborate async with a small, fast-moving team 
 
 You might be a fit if 
 
 You're a senior IC — roughly 5–8 years in — with a portfolio of expressive, culturally fluent graphic design: editorial, campaigns, identities across print and digital 
 Typography and composition are your first language 
 You can direct as well as execute: you've shaped campaigns, not just produced assets for them 
 You're plugged into visual culture across art, fashion, publishing, music, and the internet 
 You work well remotely and independently 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Editorial/publication experience (print or digital magazines) 
 Motion or illustration 
 You already make things with generative tools 
 
 Logistics 
 
 Freelance/contract, part-time to start, with room to grow 
 Fully remote, anywhere. No travel required (though you're always welcome in NYC)  
 
 To apply 
 Send your portfolio. We care about taste, range, and point of view.

Lead Product Designer 
  Team: Product, Research & Design  
   
  Prolific  
 Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 
  The Role  
 As the Product Design Lead in the Prolific for Participants Group, you will lead the design vision, strategy, and execution across three cross-functional teams. You’ll oversee participant experiences and authenticity within both our global marketplace and our dedicated specialist pool, as well as the internal services powering our participant models.  
 In addition to this leadership responsibility, you will be the hands-on designer responsible for the outcomes of a core participant domain, reporting to the VP of Product and collaborating with a world-class team of product engineers, AI researchers, and data scientists – as well as product managers and designers across Prolific. 
 You bring a background in crafting user-psychology-informed experiences for large-scale audiences and a natural ability to synthesize complex systems into elegant and transparent solutions. Thriving in ambiguity and juggling multiple initiatives, you move at a rapid pace while galvanizing exceptional performance around you. Ultimately, your success will be defined by your conceptual clarity, peer-to-peer bridge-building, and your consistent ability to bring the participant “into the room 
 Our Product, User Research, and Design Team indexes heavily on drive, commercial acumen, and pragmatism. Building on our Prolific Principles, we expect you to demonstrate reliability, grit, and bravery, and to model these traits within the team. You’ll be given a lot of trust and autonomy in return, as is always the case within Product at Prolific. 
  What you'll be doing  
 
 You'll bring your rich and varied design career experience to bear to solve customer problems and create new moments of joy for our participants who use Prolific—both ‘pocket money’ academic research participants around the world and deeply skilled experts working on AI training and evaluation. 
 You’ll build extensively for internal use cases and users, including in participant modeling platforms and tools for our Human Data Ops team. 
 You’ll raise the bar in our Design Team, and co-own cross-functional areas like accessibility (we are WCAG 2.1 AA compliant) and our Design System with other design leaders.  
 You will line-manage a group of 1-3 designers directly, and mentor others, coaching behaviours and skills, and modeling game-changing approaches by directly doing. 
 You'll have user research and data analysis responsibilities 
 
   
  What you'll bring  
 
 An extensive and varied track record of in-house product design work alongside product managers and engineers. (Pure agency experience is likely to be screened out.) 
 Experience in either line-managing or acting as player/coach for other designers. 
 Confidence working with AI prototyping tools. We use Figma Make. 
 Competence or expertise in the industry's standard design tools, principles, and methodologies, and a basic to detailed understanding of how AI models work. 
 
  Even better if you have  
 
 A lived experience of a rapidly scaling startup – especially if you loved it! 
 AI training experience, or a data science or computer science background. 
 A track record of giving back to your Product/Design community. 
 A track record of excelling across all your pursuits, beyond your chosen career. 
 
  Why Prolific is a great place to work  
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. 
 Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

Who we are  
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
 Who we are 
 Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.  
 As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually. 
  About This Role  
 We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (Design System) who thinks at a system level and understands how to create a scalable UI ecosystem that spans multiple products, teams, and platforms. You are not just designing static screens; you are building the foundation of our product user interfaces. In this role, you will take full ownership of our component libraries, interaction models, and cross-platform design consistency. You will act as the bridge between design and engineering, ensuring that our visual assets translate seamlessly into clean, reusable, and accessible production code. 
  Responsibilities  
 
 UI Craft & Visual Excellence: Maintain an exceptionally high standard for layout, typography, colour, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall digital finish across all reusable elements. 
 Component Architecture: Design, build, and maintain robust component libraries (buttons, inputs, cards, navigation, forms, tables, etc.) that scale seamlessly across products. 
 Interaction & Motion Design: Define interactive behaviors and state transitions (e.g., hover, focus, disabled, loading, and mobile behaviors) to ensure components feel alive and intuitive. 
 Design Token Management: Structure and maintain design tokens (colours, spacing, typography, border-radius, shadows) to drive consistency between design environments and code. 
 Figma Library Architecture: Organize complex variants, properties, and components within Figma to empower other product designers to build quickly and accurately. 
 Engineering Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering teams to navigate technical constraints across Web, React, Flutter, Android, and iOS/Native app environments. 
 Documentation & Governance: Create clear, comprehensive usage guidelines and documentation outlining when, why, and how components should (and should not) be used. 
 
  Experience & Background  
 
 Proven Design System Track Record: Extensive experience building, scaling, and maintaining production-ready design systems rather than just standalone product features. 
 Cross-Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of the constraints and guidelines governing multiple platforms, including Web, iOS, and Android. 
 Systems-Thinking Mindset: A portfolio demonstrating how individual design decisions impact multiple products, scale sustainably, and optimize designer/engineer workflows. 
 Front-End Alignment: Strong familiarity with how developers inspect, build, and consume components in code repositories. 
 
  Skills & Competencies  
 
 Expert Figma Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Figma libraries, auto-layout, components, variants, variables, and library publication. 
 Accessibility Champion: Solid grasp of accessibility standards (WCAG), contrast requirements, and inclusive design principles. 
 Technical Literacy: Familiarity with component-driven frameworks (React, Flutter) and Atomic Design methodology. 
 Communication & Documentation: Excellent writing and presentation skills, with an ability to translate complex design system choices into clear executive-level updates and technical guidelines. 
 
  What Success Looks Like in This Role  
 
 High Adoption & Efficiency: Design and engineering teams actively use the system, resulting in significantly accelerated product shipping cycles. 
 Flawless Cross-Platform Consistency: A unified look, feel, and interactive behavior across all customer-facing touchpoints (Web, Android, iOS). 
 Best-in-Class Documentation: A central, living source of truth that leaves no ambiguity regarding design tokens, component rules, or brand compliance. 
 Scalable Architecture: A foundational library that handles future product expansions, rebrands, or theme changes with minimal friction. 
 
  Why Join Us  
 
 Competitive compensation, benefits, and career growth opportunities. 
 Fully remote work culture and support for professional development. 
 
  How to apply:  
 Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

Work from anywhere, impact everywhere  
 Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.  We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. 
 Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.  We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.  We are committed to changing the way things are done. 
  Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position    Work from anywhere!    Position overview 
 As the Head of Design, you will lead our design organisation, owning the design quality of every customer journey end-to-end — how our client-facing touchpoints across product, web and more look, feel, and function at every step — in close partnership with Product, who own the journeys and priorities, and Marketing, who lead brand strategy and identity. 
 This is a broad executive mandate where you will own not only the craft of design but its measurable impact on the business. You will champion design excellence, build deep partnerships with Product and Marketing to ensure a single, cohesive experience from first impression to daily use, and grow a world-class remote design culture. Your mission is to translate complex financial and cryptocurrency concepts into a beautiful, cohesive, and trust-building experience — and to demonstrate, through outcomes, that great design is working. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 
  Design Strategy and Vision.  Define, champion, and execute the long-term design vision for Xapo's client-facing touchpoints across mobile and web — treating measurable user-experience quality, not just aesthetics, as the standard of success.   
  Design Performance & Outcomes.  Own the metrics that demonstrate design's business impact such as task-completion and speed in core journeys and design-system adoption, reporting on these quarterly at the executive level.   
  Operational Leadership of the Design Function.  Run design as a fully accountable business function, owning headcount planning, prioritisation, and delivery, so the organization scales predictably alongside Product and Engineering.   
  Brand Partnership and Experience Continuity.  Partner closely with Marketing, who lead Xapo's brand strategy and identity, to ensure that brand is expressed faithfully throughout the user journey — creating a seamless aesthetic and narrative transition from public campaigns to in-app transactional flows, with clear swimlanes and shared rituals between the two teams.   
  UX Architecture and Flow Optimisation.  Oversee user research and journey mapping to elevate the design and usability of complex regulatory, private banking, and crypto-native payment flows — working with Product, who own the journeys themselves, to reduce friction without compromising security.   
  Design Systems and Operations.  Scale and govern a unified design language and Figma system — co-developed with Marketing's brand team where the system touches brand expression — to drive velocity, consistency, and visual quality across product and web.   
  Operationalised Research and Testing.  Standardise a culture of data-informed design, embedding regular usability testing and customer discovery as a standard gate before handoff to ensure high-quality, validated releases.   
  Cross-Functional Executive Collaboration.  Work closely with Product and Engineering leadership so the design organisation is engaged early, bringing craft and usability expertise into strategic direction and product requirements from the earliest stages — and act as design's ambassador to Marketing, Compliance, and other key stakeholders.   
  Responsible AI Design Governance.  Partner with security and AI engineering teams to establish a safe, governed framework for utilising AI tools in asset creation and UX personalisation.   
  Team Leadership and Culture.  Recruit, mentor, and lead a remote, multi-disciplinary design organisation spanning Product Design, Research, and UX Writing, fostering a culture of craft, critique, and continuous growth. 
 
   
 Skills needed 
 
 10+ years of digital design experience, with at least 4+ years in an executive leadership role (Director/VP) managing multi-disciplinary design teams in a high-growth fintech, neobank, or digital asset platform.   
 Broad creative fluency, with a strong portfolio demonstrating complex interactive product design executed to a high aesthetic standard, and a proven ability to work within and extend an established brand identity.   
 Proven track record of improving key business and design metrics (conversion, NPS, task completion, and platform ratings) through design-led initiatives.   
 Demonstrated ability to resolve operational friction, streamline design workflows, and build high-trust partnerships with marketing, product, and engineering teams — particularly experience navigating shared ownership of brand between design and marketing functions.   
 Deep knowledge of native mobile platform guidelines (iOS and Android) and modern Web standards, along with experience scaling enterprise-grade design systems.   
 Strong familiarity with the unique UX and trust challenges in fintech, banking, and digital assets.   
 Exceptional communication and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate the business value of design decisions to the C-suite and board.   
 Operational, direct, and collaborative leadership style tailored for a fully remote, globally distributed environment. 
 
   
  Other requirements  
   
 
 A dedicated workspace. 
 A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. 
 Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. 
   Why work for Xapo? 
 Impact Globally, Work Remotely. 
 
 
  Shape the Future   Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.   
 
 
  Great work-life balance   Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.      
 
 
  Expect Excellence   Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn   how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.    
 
 
 At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

About SecurityScorecard:   
  SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.   
   Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the      World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023    and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.”  SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.   
   About the Role:   
  We're hiring a Senior UX Architect to own information architecture and structural UX across our entire product surface — new platform builds and legacy areas alike. This is a senior, horizontal role that sits just below the leadership tier and carries genuine influence over how our product is structured and how our design org thinks.  
  Today, much of our structural UX expertise lives in one place at the leadership level. This role exists to scale that expertise across every product swimlane — shifting the team from aesthetic-first to architecture-first design thinking, where great aesthetics are the  result  of sound structure, not a substitute for it. You'll also be the structural foundation our AI product work builds on, ensuring intelligent product experiences sit on top of a clean, scalable UX layer rather than inheriting structural debt.  
  This is the kind of work that quietly determines whether a product feels effortless or exhausting — and whether customers stay. If you want to be the person who sets and holds that bar across an entire platform, this is your seat.  
   What You'll Do:   
 
   Own information architecture across all surfaces.  Maintain a coherent IA across new and legacy platform areas. Audit existing structures, find the fracture points, and resolve them with a long-term foundation in mind.  
   Set and carry cross-swimlane UX standards.  Operate horizontally across every product design swimlane, ensuring structural UX thinking is applied consistently — everywhere the product lives, not just where attention happens to land.  
   Be the quality checkpoint for prototypes.  Review prototypes across product areas as a structural-integrity gate, so work moves forward faster and with confidence — and nothing ships with structural debt baked in.  
   Champion a blueprint-first design motion.  As the org adopts a blueprint-first approach (defining the  what  and  how  in low fidelity before any high-fidelity layer), you'll be the keeper of the bar — ensuring every output meets our UX, IA, and best-practice standards.  
   Elevate the design practice.  Coach and model what strong structural thinking looks like, leveling up the team so it builds things right from the start rather than requiring correction after the fact.  
   Build the UX foundation for AI products.  Partner closely with the AI product team to ensure the UX layer is structured, scalable, and ready to support intelligent product experiences.  
   Hold platform integrity — old and new.  Maintain the standard across the current platform and future builds, progressively bringing legacy areas up to standard.  
   Transfer knowledge and level the team.  Spread UX architecture thinking throughout the design org, building a team that constructs correctly from the start.  
 
   What You'll Bring:   
 
  8+ years of hands-on and/or managerial  UX experience  with deep, demonstrated expertise in  information architecture  and  structural/systems-level SaaS design .  
  A track record of owning IA across complex, multi-surface products — including untangling fractured or legacy structures.  
  The ability to set standards and influence horizontally across multiple teams without direct authority — leadership through craft and clarity.  
  Experience establishing design processes, review practices, and reusable patterns/component foundations at scale.  
  Fluency partnering with Product and Engineering on AI or platform-level initiatives, with an eye for building UX foundations that scale.  
  The judgment to know when aesthetics are doing real structural work and when they're papering over a weak foundation.  
   Leader mentality:  An excellent communicator, patient observer, and a keen feedback-giver.  
  Engineering experience (JSON, CSS, C++) / Python-ML background — a plus.  
 
  UX Architecture & IA Health  
 
  A measurable reduction in IA-related rework and structural revisions after handoff.  
  Every prototype reviewed against blueprint-first standards before progressing.  
  A clear decline in siloed design decisions across product swimlanes.  
 
  Design Velocity  
 
  Prototype review cycles compressed from weeks to days.  
  Fewer design-to-dev miscommunication loops and back-and-forth cycles.  
  Blueprint completion consistently running ahead of visual design sprints.  
 
  Customer Impact  
 
  Quarter-over-quarter NPS improvement.  
  Increased platform and customer retention.  
  Fewer support tickets and friction points tied to navigation, IA, and workflow confusion.  
 
  AI & Platform Readiness  
 
  Core platform surfaces assessed and documented as AI-ready.  
  Zero new AI features shipped on top of unresolved IA debt.  
  A clean, consistent component and pattern library established as the foundation for AI product builds.  
 
  Team Elevation  
 
  Measurable uplift in the team's blueprint-first output quality over 6–12 months.  
  A steady reduction in leadership-level intervention required on structural UX decisions.  
  UX standards adopted and self-applied across swimlanes — without top-down correction.  
 
  Who You Are:  
  Our Experience Design & Research team has a unique fabric, and we hire for it  deliberately  — at this level, how you carry it matters as much as your expertise:  
 
   You push yourself to do your best work.  You set a high structural bar and you're energized by getting the foundation right.  
   You have a growth mindset.  You seek out feedback and incorporate it, and you create the conditions for others to do the same.  
   You care about the people around you.  You're committed to elevating the whole team. This is not a "rockstar" seat — it's a force-multiplier seat. You make everyone better.  
   You lead with humility.  You're deeply experienced and entirely secure — which is exactly why you can coach, listen, and influence rather than dictate.  
 
   Benefits:   Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!  
 The estimated total compensation range for this position is $250,000 - $290,000 (base plus bonus). Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.

About  Customer.io  
 Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day.  Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. 
 About the role 
 Hi, my name is Matt W, VP of Product & Design at  Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Principal Product Designer. Principal Product Designer is the highest individual contributor design role at  Customer.io . This person shapes the design vision for the company and influences how design is practiced here — through their own craft, through the standards their work sets, and through the partnerships they build with product and engineering leadership. 
  Customer.io  is in a transformational moment: executing against a strong current product while redesigning what the product is and how it's experienced by a new generation of builders. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go. 
 This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire. 
 About you 
 You have a fully formed point of view on how AI changes what software means — for the people who use it, the people who build it, and the agents that increasingly operate it. You have the conviction to put that view to work across a product and an organization. You lead through clarity and example, give candid feedback that improves the work, and operate with humility and curiosity even outside your own expertise. 
 What we value 
 
  Leads through clarity and example, not control.  You shape culture through your own practice — not top-down direction. 
  Candid craft feedback.  You give feedback that improves the work, even when it's uncomfortable. 
  Humility and curiosity.  You operate with openness, especially in areas outside your expertise. 
  Amplifying others.  You raise the impact of people across the whole company — not just the design team. 
  Bias for craft.  You stay close to the work by choice, and that proximity is how you lead. 
 
 Some things you'll do 
 
  Shape and communicate a design vision for  Customer.io 's product as a whole  — the coherent, long-range picture of what excellent looks like for our customers, brought into rooms where product direction gets set 
  Drive the strategic direction of Pluma , our design system — architecture, evolution, deprecation decisions, and the principles that govern how it scales 
  Close the gap between design intent and shipped product  — stay close enough to implementation to catch divergence, and fix it directly when code is the right tool 
  Design for builder and developer audiences  — CLI-native flows, API-first onboarding, and interfaces built for people who type before they click 
  Lead the design of agentic and human-AI surfaces  across the product — develop the philosophy and advocate for the standards 
  Partner with product and engineering leadership on product strategy  — bring design into the conversation before direction is set, not after 
  Develop and advocate for  Customer.io 's AI product design philosophy  as a framework the whole team builds from 
  Lead design review for major initiatives  and bring accountability for quality and coherence across what ships 
  Develop Staff designers  through direct mentorship, critique, and the clarity of your own example 
  Contribute to hiring and calibration  — assess candidates with conviction and help the team develop a shared language for what excellent looks like 
 
 What we're looking for 
 
  10+ years of product design experience  with a portfolio demonstrating design vision and organizational impact, not just individual craft 
 Track record of  shaping design direction at the company level  — influenced what gets built and why, not just how it looks 
  Designed for developer and builder audiences  — CLI, API-first onboarding, or infrastructure-native products 
  Developed point of view on AI and agentic product design  — has shipped AI-native interfaces and can articulate a philosophy on interaction models for agentic and delegated use 
  Contributed to a design system at the strategic level  — shaped what it should be and shouldn't be, and advocated for those decisions over time 
  Operates with influence without authority  — track record of aligning product, engineering, and exec leadership around a design direction without a management title 
  Has raised the craft bar at an organizational level  — through critique culture, standards, and the example others internalize 
  Executive-level communication  — connects design decisions to customer impact, product differentiation, and business outcomes 
  B2B SaaS depth  — understands complex, data-heavy products and has opinions about where the interaction model breaks 
 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is  $245k-$276k USD , depending on experience and subject to market-rate adjustment. 
 We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including  100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer  16 weeks of paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. 
 See full benefits here → 
 Our Process 
 No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 
 
 30 minute call with Recruiter 
 45 minute call and portfolio review with Hiring Manager 
 30 minute call with cross-functional partner 
 60 minute design case call with members of the design & tech team 
 
 All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

About  Customer.io

Customer.io  powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. 
 About the role 
 Hi, my name is Matt Wensing, VP Product & Design at  Customer.io , and I’m looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the design of a product area end to end — from strategy through shipped pixels. 
 We’re a lean design team working on a sophisticated B2B platform that millions of messages flow through every day. This role is for designers who insist on owning outcomes, not just deliverables — who see implementation as part of the job, treat the design system as something they contribute to, and have a real point of view on how AI changes interaction design in their area. You’ll shape what we build within your domain, not just how it looks. 
 What we value 
 
  Design Craft over decoration  — we care about interactions that work, flows that don’t lose users, and systems that hold up over time. 
  Ownership through implementation  — you don’t hand off and walk away. You close the gap between design and shipped product, including in code when that’s the right tool. 
  AI as a design factor  — we expect a thoughtful perspective on how AI changes interaction models, not just awareness that AI exists. 
  Candor in critique  — we give and receive honest feedback because it’s the fastest path to better work. 
  Systems thinking over one-off solutions  — we build patterns, not just screens. 
 
 What you'll do 
 
 Own the design of a product area end to end — strategy, flows, edge cases, and shipped quality. 
 Design flows, not just screens — identify where users will get stuck before they do, and treat self-service (onboarding, activation, recovery) as a primary discipline. 
 Close the gap between design and shipped product — pair with engineering during implementation, catch regressions, and contribute directly in code: Pluma components, production UI fixes, interaction prototypes. 
 Contribute actively to Pluma, our design system — use it well, propose extensions thoughtfully, fix inconsistencies, and step into stewardship of components adjacent to your work. 
 Develop a point of view on AI in your product area — prototype the interaction, not just the screen, and treat uncertainty, latency, and reversibility as real design factors. 
 Partner with PM and Engineering on roadmap and tradeoffs — bring UX into the conversation early, push back when it shortchanges the user, and own the quality of your area over time. 
 Mentor designers earlier in their career through pairing, critique, and the example set by your own work. 
 
 What we're looking for 
 
 5+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating craft, ownership, and a clear point of view on shipped work. 
 Strong flow literacy — you design end-to-end experiences across states, edge cases, and recovery paths, not isolated screens. 
 Closes the design-to-implementation gap — partners tightly with engineering, catches regressions, and contributes directly in code. Code fluency is a real and growing expectation at this level. 
 Experienced power user of a design system — you can describe how you’ve extended it thoughtfully, where you’ve pushed back on a pattern, and how you decide when to use a primitive vs. propose a new one. 
 Has designed or shipped AI-involved interfaces and can talk specifically about how you handled uncertainty, latency, or reversibility — even at small scale. 
 B2B SaaS experience with complex, data-driven interfaces — you understand systems, not just screens. 
 Strong communication and critique skills — brings rationale to decisions, gives feedback that improves the work, and can change your mind when you find better evidence.

We also offer  16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

 Our Backend Engineering team builds all of the highly scalable distributed services that power Arize’s ML observability platform.  Write maintainable, scalable, and performant backend code primarily in Go, Java, and Python, with opportunities to work in TypeScript. 
 Build high-volume and highly available analytics systems. 
 Design and build APIs specific to our customers’ Machine Learning and LLM workflows. 
 Prototype, optimize, and maintain scalable backend services that power the Arize core platform. 
 Extend, and contribute back to, open source OLAP databases and distributed message queue frameworks. 
 Develop and integrate collection tools for robust monitoring of ML and LLM pipelines. 
 Research and implement cutting-edge visualization & dimensionality reduction algorithms in a distributed environment. 
 Collaborate with our product, design, and directly with customer engineering teams to enhance and expand our product offerings. 
 Contribute to the build our own in-house AI Agents 
 
  What We’re Looking For  
 
 5+ years of experience working with high-performance backend systems. 
 Strong experience writing Go, Python, TypeScript/Node, Java, or similar server programming languages. 
 Enthusiasm and interest in the AI and LLM ecosystem, with a desire to learn and stay updated on emerging technologies. 
 Previous work building and operating highly complex SaaS platforms/systems. 
 Knowledge of working with public clouds & container orchestration - AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, etc. 
 
  Bonus Points, But Not Required  
 
 Experience with distributed stream processing - Kafka, Gazette, or similar. 
 Experience with OLAP systems. 
 Familiarity with system observability tooling like Prometheus. 
 Working knowledge of Machine Learning and/or Data Science. 
 First-hand experience working with large language models (LLMs) or developing AI products.

afe50b682882265e.title: Director of Engineering - Core Product (USA)
afe50b682882265e.jd:
About Kalepa: 
 Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work. 
 We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time. 
 Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started. 
 Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber. 
 Our Values (This is important): 
 Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees.  
 Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles: 
 
  Hustle and Determination  - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win. 
  Deliver Customer Impact  - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it. 
  Meritocracy  - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here. 
  Transparency  - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth. 
  Experiment Relentlessly  - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage. 
 
 In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena). 
 Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.     About the role:  
  Salary range: $230K – $350K USD*  
 Kalepa is looking for an exceptional Director of Engineering to lead and grow Kalepa’s Core Product team. We are looking for a deeply technical leader with extensive experience in full-stack engineering who is excited to partner closely with the executive team and cross-functional leaders to shape the future of Kalepa’s product. You will be responsible for defining the architectural roadmap, setting strategy, driving engineering operational excellence, and cultivating a high-performance, results-driven culture that consistently delivers exceptional value to Kalepa’s clients. 
 As part of the Core Product team, you will establish the frameworks, engineering standards, and cross-functional cadences to power Kalepa’s cutting-edge platform which augments human underwriters and orchestrates AI underwriters to deliver rapid and profitable growth to the world’s largest insurers. You will bridge the gap between product vision and technical execution, ensuring our technology investments directly drive business impact and long-term business growth. This role is ideal for someone who cares deeply about quality, is actively rethinking the way that software is built and shipped, and wants to shape the way Kalepa impacts the most critical decisions made at the largest insurance companies. 
  About you:  
 
 You have 10+ years of relevant software engineering experience with at least 3 years of full-time engineering people management experience, ideally including experience managing managers and scaling organizations. 
 You are known for rethinking the way that engineering is done and feel right at home managing both human and AI agents, while ensuring quality and reliability. 
 You have a proven track record of driving complex, large-scale engineering initiatives and aligning technical strategy with broader company objectives. 
 You are an excellent recruiter of top-tier engineering talent and somebody who exceptional software engineers want to work with. 
 You have the ability to make the tradeoffs required to ship high-quality code while working within the constraints of a fast-growing company. 
 You drive operational excellence by championing metrics-driven decision-making and implementing robust engineering practices. 
 You thrive on experimentation: you're comfortable testing ideas, measuring results, and iterating quickly on problems no one has solved before. 
 You have deep architectural expertise and a strong foundation in system design, distributed systems, and scalable infrastructure. 
 You have experience overseeing and scaling platforms utilizing serverless technologies (Lambda, EC2), asynchronous workflows, and modern cloud environments. 
 
  What you’ll get:  
 
 Competitive salary (based on experience level). 
 Significant equity options package. 
 401(k) plan with employer match (regardless of employee contribution) 
 Excellent benefits: 100% covered medical, 100% covered vision and dental for individuals and families, and others 
 Work with an ambitious, smart, global, and fun team to transform a $7T global industry. 
 20 days of PTO a year 
 Global team offsites (2021 - Playa del Carmen, 2022 - Rome, 2023 - Buenos Aires, 2024 - Lisbon, 2025 - Cartagena) 
 Healthy living/gym stipend. Mobile phone bill stipend. 
 Continuing education credits. 
 
 * The salary range listed is an estimate and will vary based on a variety of factors. Final compensation will be determined during the offer stage based on relevant experience, performance during the interview process, and geographic location, and may therefore differ from the posted range.

dc75d1ae9b458bf3.title: Product Designer
dc75d1ae9b458bf3.location: Worldwide, but must be willing to attend regular EST meetings
dc75d1ae9b458bf3.jd:
JTX is our trading app, and it runs on the fastest market infrastructure on Solana, which we also built. It’s live today, self-custodial, and native mobile apps are in development.  
  We’re looking for a Product Designer to focus mainly on JTX, but you’ll also have the chance to help with other Jito products as needed.  
  We’re a small team and have already found product-market fit. This shapes the way we work:  
 
 
  You’ll make real decisions, not just work through a backlog set by others.  
 
 
  We release features and learn from real user feedback, rather than getting stuck in endless debates.  
 
 
  Attention to detail is essential here. For a trading product, the small things make all the difference.  
 
 
  About the Position  
  You’ll work on UX and UI for both web and native mobile. Right now, our main challenge is making JTX feel clear and trustworthy at a glance, not just functional. You’ll also help keep things consistent between web and mobile, and pitch in on marketing design when needed.  
  You’ll work closely with engineering and product to make the most important decisions. If you’ve ever thought about how traders read a screen under pressure and want to create the product layer that makes speed tangible, this could be the right fit for you.  
  What You’ll Do  
 
 
  Design for JTX across web and mobile, including order entry, market data, charts, positions, execution visibility, onboarding, and wallet flows.  
 
 
  Take features from defining the problem through UX and final UI.  
 
 
  Own and improve the design system and token library that our engineers use.  
 
 
  Help with marketing design when needed, like landing pages, social assets, and launch materials.  
 
 
  Jump in on design work for other Jito products when the team needs extra help.  
 
 
  Release, observe real usage, and keep improving.  
 
 
  Requirements  
 
 
  Strong product sense: you can explain why a decision is right, not just that it looks good.  
 
 
  You can spot issues with hierarchy and clarity on a busy screen and explain what’s causing them.  
 
 
  You’re comfortable working across research, UX, and UI, just like any early-stage product designer needs to.

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Design team at ElevenLabs is crafting experiences for the next generation of audio workflows using generative AI. You’ll work in entirely new and unexplored problem spaces, like crafting experiences around voice cloning that will allow people to generate content in realistic voices, languages, and accents, to create universally accessible content, safely. You’ll reimagine how creative teams craft sounds just by describing them, and how they bring it all together in one AI-first generative audio platform. The work here has the potential to revolutionize workflows for creators to media and entertainment, publishing giants, to defining entirely new spaces like conversational AI companies.

You will work with our Engineering and AI Research teams to successfully communicate, evolve, and execute a strong product design standard that showcases ElevenLabs as an innovator in the generative AI audio space. You are a crucial component of our company’s growth and product launches through your contributions to short and long-term strategic direction, creating and maintaining high visual standards and a strong focus on user needs. You have an owner’s mentality, taking pride in your work and in your team’s work, and view what you do as a part-owner and builder of ElevenLabs.

You'll work closely with Nev Flynn https://nevflynn.com/,  Austin Malerba https://x.com/austin_malerba?lang=en, and collaborate closely with our frontend engineers to achieve outcomes.

If you love the intersection of design and engineering, as well as having an interest in the business side this could be a great fit. You might be a designer turned engineer, an engineer turned designer, or an ex-founder.



WHAT YOU BRING

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic product designers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects and designs. Even directly sharing a rough figma of your work is a great way to show us your craft! We do require:

 - Creative thinking toward establishing and executing on the vision for team initiatives. Challenge the status quo, push innovation and inspire people toward a unified outcome.

 - Efficiently execute to ship products that deliver impact for our business and customers.

 - Partner with the leadership team to successfully communicate concisely across the team and influence product and design outcomes.

 - Will work across the entire business stack and make an impact at different stages of the product: building vision & strategy, ensuring all the loose ends are tied up when executing, and making sure the operational components to support onboarding are in place, not just the product

 - It is preferred that you can get in the weeds with your engineering partners and make sense of technical constraints, while still pushing forward and maintaining a high design bar and level of execution

 - Work closely with stakeholders across the organization, partnering with Engineering, Customer Support, and Growth to define new products and features and launch them




LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in  London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-remote

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.




TEAM INTEGRATION

 - Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

 - Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

 - Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

 - Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success




ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

 - Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

 - Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

 - Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

 - Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

 - Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.

 - Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.

 - Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.

 - Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.



ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:


PRODUCT DESIGN

 - Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.

 - Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.

 - Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.

 - Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.

 - Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).

 - Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.


UX RESEARCH & STRATEGY

 - Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.

 - Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.

 - Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.

 - Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.

 - Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.

 - Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.

 - Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in  design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.


WEB & BRAND EXPERIENCE

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.

 - Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.

 - Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.

 - A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.

Why WunderGraph?

The Process

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 5000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.



The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to lead design for Paddle's Core Experience team, the horizontal team responsible for the foundations every other product is built on: sign-up, onboarding, the design system, and the overall Seller Experience. The Core Experience team owns the connective, cross-cutting experience that ties Paddle's products together.

This is a different kind of design role. Rather than owning a single product surface, you'll own the connective tissue that makes Paddle feel like one coherent product. When a seller signs up, gets onboarded, moves between products, or encounters an AI-powered or integrated experience, your work is what makes it feel effortless.

You'll be an active contributor to Paddle's integration and AI experiences, helping shape how Paddle connects to the wider tooling ecosystem and where AI genuinely improves the seller experience. This role asks for exceptional UI craft, deep design systems expertise, and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change both the products we build and the way we design them.

As a holistic problem solver, you'll operate well beyond pixels, balancing hands-on execution with systems thinking, influence, and a high bar for quality. Embedded in a cross-functional team alongside Product and Engineering, you'll work in an environment that values ownership, autonomy, and accountability.



What you'll do:

 - Own the end-to-end design of Paddle's foundational seller experiences, sign-up, onboarding, and the surfaces that connect our products together, from discovery and concepting through delivery, iteration, and long-term evolution.

 - Act as a horizontal partner to all other product teams, creating the guidelines, principles, and reusable patterns that keep the experience consistent across the platform as Paddle grows.

 - Contribute actively to integration and AI experiences, shaping interaction patterns and surfaces, and forming a clear point of view on where AI delivers real user value (and where it gets in the way).

 - Lead design thinking for foundational work, including information architecture, interaction patterns, accessibility, and scalable component design.

 - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Stakeholders to define problems, shape solutions, influence roadmaps, and ship high-quality outcomes.

 - Use research, data, and customer feedback to validate decisions and continuously improve the experience.

 - Set and uphold quality and craft standards across the product organisation, advocating for user-centred design and a high design bar.

 - Use storytelling to build alignment and secure buy-in for foundational, cross-cutting work that often spans many teams.

 - Bring a strong portfolio with exceptional UI craft, showcasing end-to-end product design with clear problem-solving, interaction design, and visual clarity in complex domains.

 - Have proven experience owning, building, and maintaining design systems, leading their direction, designing components, writing documentation, establishing governance, and driving adoption across teams.

As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

 Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish  hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.
